scientific_integrity: The source normal form and automorphism subgroup are separated from the new deductions. Smoothness, branching, and generic boundary types are proved algebraically and the critical polynomial identities are replayed by an exact symbolic checker.
scientific_limitations: The abstract quotient signature is already tabulated and is not claimed as new. Higher-codimension intersections of discriminant components and parameter-equivalence classes are not classified. The conic is the quotient by the distinguished C3^2 subgroup; on automorphism-jump loci it need not be the full automorphism quotient.
title: Conic discriminant and codimension-one boundary of the \(C_3^2\) plane-sextic normal form
